lessons: Paging current recurrence projections and then loading exact histories splits selection and audit evidence across storage snapshots.
Safe event-level continuation would require prior validated state or snapshot proof, so the bounded slice pages streams while fully replaying each selected lifecycle.
Validated lookahead proves continuation; corruption before the cursor, beyond lookahead, and in unrelated stream families cannot block the selected page.
The read-only projection adds no occurrence lifecycle, clock, cursor persistence, mutation, worker, lease, dispatch, retry, permission, or execution authority.
